commentary.text: 90+7' That's the end of the match.
90+7' Juan Martinez Munuera shows a yellow card to Alex Sola (Alaves), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
90+6' Alaves can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
90+4' Alex Sola (Alaves) had time and space on the edge of the box but sent his effort just over the bar.
90+2' Ianis Hagi (Alaves) approaches the edge of the box with intent and shoots, but Inaki Pena rushes out to narrow the angle and smothers the ball. Good goalkeeping!
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
